Toolbar search matches subject, from, and body already synced to this computer. Press Enter to search or apply a revised term. Clearing the search field returns to the message list with its filters. It returns up to 100 ranked search results as metadata without copying message bodies; opening a result reads its full content on demand. Account-scoped searches filter each token's candidates before aggregation and preserve AND, prefix matching and field weights. When the local index needs repair, opening shows preparation progress and works in saved batches, yielding between them. Opening also names copy, journal recovery, schema, body metadata and final preparation phases; these are not an overall startup percentage. Mail and search become available after verification. Quitting keeps committed progress for the next open. No mail is downloaded by rebuilding. A large individual message or disk call can still cause a pause.
